output.headline: Accepts a $25,000 Schwab Charitable grant through Oakland Public Education Fund for PreK teacher training
output.summary: The district accepts $25,000 from Schwab Charitable, passed through the Oakland Public Education Fund, for its early childhood education program. The grant covers July 1, 2022 through June 30, 2023.

output.summary: The Board ratifies ending the district's 2022-2023 services agreement with STAC Physical Therapy Emeryville, Inc. The district ended it for convenience under Section 11.a of the agreement, which means no cause is required. The text states no dollar amount.

output.headline: Approves a data-sharing agreement with Viatron Systems for the 1000 Broadway digitalization project
output.summary: This agreement sets the rules for how the district shares data with Viatron Systems and how Viatron must protect it. It covers work under a separate general service agreement for the Central Office 1000 Broadway Digitalization Project. No dollar amount is stated.

output.summary: The board adopts the 2021-2022 Measure N carryover plan and budget for Aspire Lionel Wilson Preparatory Academy, in the amount of $73,577.96. The Measure N Commission recommended it. Measure N is the local measure that funds college and career readiness programs in district high schools.

output.summary: The board adopts the 2021-2022 Measure N carryover plan and budget for East Bay Innovation Academy, in the amount of $16,638.31. The Measure N Commission recommended it. Measure N is the local measure that funds college and career readiness programs in district high schools.

output.headline: Buys Finalsite website platform and setup for up to $263,930 through 2025, without a district bid
output.summary: The district is buying website setup and a hosting platform for its district and school websites, including the staff intranet, from Finalsite. The cost is $77,350 in one-time setup fees plus $93,290 a year in licensing and hosting for 2023-24 and 2024-25. The district is buying through another agency's existing contract (the Education Technology Joint Powers Authority) instead of running its own bid.

output.headline: Approves Ralph J. Bunche Academy for Measure N full implementation in 2023-24, up to $51,069.39
output.summary: The board adopts the Measure N Commission's recommendation that Ralph J. Bunche Academy receive "Full Implementation" funding at $850 per pupil for the 2023-24 school year, now that it is off probation. The amount cannot exceed $51,069.39. Measure N funds college and career readiness programs in district high schools.

output.summary: Public Works, LLC will provide a team to analyze each Continuous School Improvement department against the district's goals and make recommendations on how those departments are set up. output.headline: Pays a consultant up to $45,000 to help write Phase 2 of the George Floyd school safety plan
output.summary: An independent consultant will attend design team meetings, track action items, review how other districts pair school safety with positive school climate, and help write the Phase 2 George Floyd Implementation Plan. The agreement runs October 3, 2022 through June 30, 2023, so work began before this approval.

output.headline: Pays Wellness Together up to $40,000 for a mental health consultant across about 50 weeks

The agreement runs August 27, 2022 through June 1, 2023, so work began before this approval.

output.summary: Stanford University will help train district staff to use a research-validated approach for students returning to school from the juvenile justice system and provide training materials. Both are at no cost to the district, and the training term runs November 29, 2022 through June 30, 2024.
